title: CPSC, Toymax Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Skeet Shoot Game Cartridges
summary: The Skeet Shoot games' cartridges can be defective, and can cause the projector to overheat, melt and smoke, presenting a risk of burns to consumers. Units: Approximately 435,000.

title: Chairs Recalled by Boston Warehouse Trading Corp.
summary: The screws holding the chair's front leg folding mechanism can work loose, causing the chair to collapse, resulting in injury. Units: About 1,800.

title: Converters Recalled by Coast Electronics Supply
summary: The product presents an electrical shock hazard because the unplugged end of the cord is energized when the other end is plugged in. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, BISSELL® Homecare Inc. Announce Recall of Upright Vacuum Cleaners
summary: The power cord insulation can tear where the cord attaches to the vacuum, exposing bare wires. This poses a risk of shock and burns to consumers. Units: About 207,000.

title: CPSC, The Standard Mattress Co. Announce Futon Recall
summary: Some of these futons may fail cigarette ignition resistance tests, in violation of the federal Flammable Fabrics Act, because the boric acid flame retardant inside the futons may not have been evenly disbursed. title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Children's Lamps
summary: The lamps can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 208,000.

title: CPSC, Graco Announce Recall of Infant Swings
summary: The restraint systems on the older swings consist of a waist belt only and a hinged or removable tray, which serves as a restraint. If parts are missing, the restraints are not used, or the tray pops off, infants can slip down into the seat and strangle or fall from the swing. Units: About 7 million

title: CPSC, Proctor-Silex Announce Recall of Toasters
summary: The heating elements in these toasters can remain on after the toast pops up. This poses a fire hazard. Units: About 95,000.

title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Lawnmowers
summary: The lawnmowers' fuel tanks' seam can split or crack, leaking fuel, and creating a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 112,000.

title: CPSC, John Deere Consumer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Homelite® Handheld Power Blowers/Vacuums
summary: The fuel line location can cause it to contact the edge of the engine shroud, causing the line to prematurely wear. This can result in a gasoline leak, presenting a fire hazard and causing burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 200,000.

title: CPSC, Healthtex Announce Recall of Baby Garments
summary: Snaps on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to babies. Units: About 260,000.

title: CPSC, Sta-Rite Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Battery Chargers
summary: The battery chargers can overheat and ignite, melting the charger housing and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,000.
